payload.title: Mykonos Wedding Guide to Venues, Seasons and Paperwork
payload.excerpt: Plan a Mykonos wedding: choose an area and venue style, weigh the seasons, sort legal or symbolic paperwork and get your guests to the island with ease.
key_takeaways: Decide early whether your ceremony will be legal or symbolic, because that choice sets the paperwork and the timeline.
Choose the area and the kind of venue first, then narrow to names using the full Mykonos venues guide.
June to August are the driest months at Naxos, the nearest official weather station, with May and September milder, so plan ceremony times around summer heat and the north wind.
Ask every venue about deposits, cancellation, exclusive use and music times, and get the answers in writing before you commit.

faq.q: Can you legally get married in Mykonos?
faq.a: There are two routes: a civil marriage on the island, or a legal step in Australia followed by a symbolic ceremony on Mykonos. For a civil marriage, check the steps, documents and any fees with the Municipality of Mykonos and the Australian Embassy in Athens. In most cases an overseas marriage is recognised in Australia if it was valid where it took place and would have been valid under Australian law.

faq.q: What documents do Australians need to get married in Greece?
faq.a: The most common are a Certificate of No Impediment to Marriage and certificates from a registry of births, deaths and marriages, and local authorities may also ask for divorce papers, a late spouse's death certificate, and your original birth certificate and passport. Ask the Greek authority which documents it needs and which must carry an apostille or authentication.

faq.q: Can we have a symbolic ceremony in Mykonos?
faq.a: Yes. You can complete the legal step in Australia, then hold a symbolic ceremony on the island. A legal marriage in Greece is in most cases recognised in Australia, though it cannot be registered here; a legal step at home simply keeps the paperwork in Australia.

faq.q: Is Mykonos a good place to elope?
faq.a: It suits a small wedding well. Kivotos describes its private chapel as ideal for an intimate wedding, and newlyweds there may spend their first days aboard the hotel's privately owned schooner.

faq.q: When is the wedding season in Mykonos?
faq.a: The tourist season runs from May to October. At Naxos, the nearest official weather station, June to August are driest, while October brings the most rain of those months and the north wind runs stronger from July to October.

faq.q: How do wedding guests get to Mykonos?
faq.a: Guests can fly from Athens, about 45 minutes, or from Thessaloniki, about 1 hour 10 minutes. They can also arrive by ferry or catamaran, which can be delayed or cancelled in strong winds.
